title: AudioDesignInput
$comment: Internal bookkeeping slot (user_visible: false in artifact_contract.json). Carries the user's intake parameters across all phases. Plain domain-shaped JSON — NOT subject to the user-visible artifact protocol (no slot/display_name/content_layout/content wrapper).

media_url.description: Public URL of the source video. ffprobe / ffmpeg / dl transcribe all consume this directly.

media_kind.description: Always 'video' for this skill (audio-only inputs are out of scope per SKILL.md trigger patterns).

total_duration_sec.description: Total source duration in float seconds, probed by ffprobe in Phase 01. May be null when first written, patched in after probe.

language_hint.description: ASR language hint: 'auto' (default), or ISO-639-1 code like 'en', 'zh', 'ja'.

narrative_context.description: Optional one-paragraph synopsis / setup helping the sound designer in Phase 03. May be empty.
